description: Header file defining the internal implementation of a raw hash map class template within the Abseil C++ library, including methods for insertion, assignment, and element access.

classes.name: raw_hash_map
classes.description: Template class implementing a hash map based on raw hash set, supporting insertion, assignment, and element access.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Inserts or assigns a key-value pair into the hash map, supporting various argument types and overloads.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to construct and insert an element if the key does not already exist, with overloads supporting different argument types.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Provides access to the mapped value associated with a key, throwing an exception if the key is not found.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts an element with the given key, returning a reference to the mapped value.

methods.name: insert_or_assign_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for insert_or_assign, handling the insertion or update logic.

methods.name: try_emplace_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for try_emplace, handling the construction and insertion of new elements.
